name: Currency Exchange
definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.

OriginalAmount.name: Original Amount
OriginalAmount.definition: Amount in its original currency when conversion from/into another currency has occurred.

UnitCurrency.name: Unit Currency
UnitCurrency.definition: Currency in which the rate of exchange is expressed in a currency exchange. In the example 1GBP = xxxCUR, the unit currency is GBP.

QuotedCurrency.name: Quoted Currency
QuotedCurrency.definition: Currency into which the base currency is converted, in a currency exchange.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: The value of one currency expressed in relation to another currency. ExchangeRate expresses the ratio between UnitCurrency and QuotedCurrency (ExchangeRate = UnitCurrency/QuotedCurrency).

ResultingAmount.name: Resulting Amount
ResultingAmount.definition: Amount of money resulting from a foreign exchange transaction.

QuotationDate.name: Quotation Date
QuotationDate.definition: Date and time at which an exchange rate is quoted.

SourceCurrency.name: Source Currency
SourceCurrency.definition: Currency of the amount to be converted in a currency conversion.

TargetCurrency.name: Target Currency
TargetCurrency.definition: Currency into which an amount is to be converted in a currency conversion.

RateType.name: Rate Type
RateType.definition: Specifies the type used to complete the currency exchange.

ExchangeRateBase.name: Exchange Rate Base
ExchangeRateBase.definition: Expresses the ratio between the base of the denomination of the Unit Currency to the base of the denomination of the Quoted Currency.

QuoteIdentification.name: Quote Identification
QuoteIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the quote issued by the ForeignExchangeAgent.

CurrencyExchangeForForeignExchangeTrade.name: Currency Exchange For Foreign Exchange Trade
CurrencyExchangeForForeignExchangeTrade.definition: Trade which uses the specified exchange rate.

RelatedCorporateActionEvent.name: Related Corporate Action Event
RelatedCorporateActionEvent.definition: Corporate action for which the offeror/issuer has specified an exchange rate for the payment in a currency different from the announced one.

CurrencyExchangeForSecuritiesBalance.name: Currency Exchange For Securities Balance
CurrencyExchangeForSecuritiesBalance.definition: Specifies a securities balance which used a specific exchange rate.

CalculatedAssetValue.name: Calculated Asset Value
CalculatedAssetValue.definition: Asset value calculated in a different currency.

CurrencyExchangeForCashEntry.name: Currency Exchange For Cash Entry
CurrencyExchangeForCashEntry.definition: Cash entry to which the currency exchange parameters apply.

RelatedPayment.name: Related Payment
RelatedPayment.definition: Payment for which currency exchange parameters are specified.

RelatedLimitManagement.name: Related Limit Management
RelatedLimitManagement.definition: Limit for which an exchange rate is specified.

FixingConditions.name: Fixing Conditions
FixingConditions.definition: Set of parameters used to calculate a rate for instance, the fixing rate to be applied to a non-deliverable agreement.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Tax for which exchange information is provided.

RelatedInvoice.name: Related Invoice
RelatedInvoice.definition: Invoice for which currency exchange information is specified.

CurrencyExchangeForTransactionAdministra.name: Currency Exchange For Transaction Administrator
CurrencyExchangeForTransactionAdministra.definition: Set of applications which use currency exchange information.

ReportedAccount.name: Reported Account
ReportedAccount.definition: Specifies the account which uses an exchange rate to report entries and balances.

CurrencyExchangeForCorporateActionCashEn.name: Currency Exchange For Corporate Action Cash Entitlement
CurrencyExchangeForCorporateActionCashEn.definition: Cash entitlement for which an exchange rate is specified.

PaymentExecution.name: Payment Execution
PaymentExecution.definition: Payment execution process for which currrency exchange information is provided.

CurrencyExchangeForSecuritiesQuote.name: Currency Exchange For Securities Quote
CurrencyExchangeForSecuritiesQuote.definition: Quote which uses currency exchange information.

CurrencyExchangeForSecuritiesConversion.name: Currency Exchange For Securities Conversion
CurrencyExchangeForSecuritiesConversion.definition: Securities conversion for which a conversion currency is specified.

CurrencyExchangeForCashDistribution.name: Currency Exchange For Cash Distribution
CurrencyExchangeForCashDistribution.definition: Cash distribution for which a conversion currency is specified.

Adjustment.name: Adjustment
Adjustment.definition: Fees or commission applied to the currency exchange.

RelatedPaymentTracker.name: Related Payment Tracker
RelatedPaymentTracker.definition: Payment tracker to what the Informations of the currency exchange are related to.

ForeignExchangeAgent.name: Foreign Exchange Agent
ForeignExchangeAgent.definition: Agent who undertakes the conversion of funds from the unit currency to the quoted currency.
